target: doctor.sh — FORGE set only in ./.env reports its source as .env, not env (check sees the pre-load environment)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://example.test/o/r.git
printf 'FORGE=github\n' > .env
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has kind_line 'github'
printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -F github | grep -qF .env && echo source_dotenv=yes || echo source_dotenv=no
fx_done
